Disorders of memory — amnesia (anterograde, retrograde), confabulation, déjà vu, jamais vu, paramnesia

TCA side effects — anticholinergic effects, cardiac toxicity, overdose lethality

Atypical antipsychotics in bipolar disorder (olanzapine, quetiapine, aripiprazole, lurasidone)

Postpartum mood disorders — baby blues, postpartum depression, postpartum psychosis

Panic disorder — panic attacks (palpitations, sweating, trembling, shortness of breath, chest pain, derealization, fear of dying/losing control), agoraphobia, management (SSRIs, CBT, benzodiazepines)
Social anxiety disorder (social phobia) — performance anxiety, management (SSRIs, CBT, beta-blockers for performance anxiety)

OCD-related disorders — body dysmorphic disorder, hoarding disorder, trichotillomania, excoriation (skin-picking) disorder

Adjustment disorder — types (with depressed mood, anxiety, mixed, disturbance of conduct)
Complex PTSD

Opioid withdrawal — clinical features (lacrimation, rhinorrhea, yawning, piloerection, diarrhea, mydriasis), management (clonidine, buprenorphine, methadone)
Opioid substitution therapy — methadone maintenance, buprenorphine-naloxone
Cannabis use disorder — clinical features (euphoria, red eyes, increased appetite, amotivational syndrome), synthetic cannabinoids

Benzodiazepine dependence and withdrawal — seizure risk, gradual tapering
Tobacco/nicotine dependence — Fagerström test, management (NRT, bupropion, varenicline)
Inhalant abuse (volatile substance abuse) — sudden sniffing death
Hallucinogens — LSD, psilocybin, PCP (phencyclidine), MDMA (ecstasy)
